content: MuJoCo EGL headless on Colab: (1) apt-get install libglfw3 libglew-dev libosmesa6-dev libgles2 libglvnd0 libegl-dev, (2) Create /usr/share/glvnd/egl_vendor.d/10_nvidia.json with {"file_format_version":"1.0.0","ICD":{"library_path":"libEGL_nvidia.so.0"}} — Colab does not install NVIDIA EGL ICD via apt, (3) Set os.environ['MUJOCO_GL']='egl' BEFORE any import of mujoco or robosuite. On macOS use MUJOCO_GL=glfw but Linux Colab must use egl. osmesa works without GPU but is CPU-only. IMPORTANT: MUJOCO_GL must be set in Python with os.environ before ANY mujoco import — cannot be set in cell after mujoco is already imported in a previous cell.
